accessNotes: The public fundingpips.com and app.fundingpips.com pages still returned HTTP 403 bot checkpoints. FundingPips' own Help Center remained readable through its public Zendesk API. The official Compare Account Models article (updated 2026-08-07) now contains an embedded USD price table, so 27 live listed tiers are priced from a FundingPips-owned source. No price was recorded for the disputed $2,500 tiers: today's Pro and Standard product pages and the comparison table start at $5K, while the older Free Trial article still says '$2,500 size is paid evaluations only.' The raw capture retains those two tiers with null prices and documents the conflict. The comparison script also retains prices for a legacy 10%-target Standard variant even though the current Standard article says that target is no longer offered; only current 8%-target prices are captured.

rules.news: Evaluation: no restrictions. Master Account: cannot open or close positions within a 10-minute window (5 minutes before and 5 minutes after) around a high-impact event on affected currencies; profits are deducted. Trades opened at least 5 hours before the event are exempt. Purposely trading news is prohibited.
rules.weekend: Permitted during evaluation. Temporarily not allowed on 1 Step Flex Master Accounts since 29 January 2026; open trades are automatically closed and this is not a hard breach.
rules.overnight: Allowed. Optional Swap-Free add-on on MT5 for Forex and Metals.
rules.ea: Third-party EAs permitted only as trade or risk managers; personal EAs may automate with proof of ownership.
rules.copyTrading: Permitted between the trader's own FundingPips accounts and outbound; prohibited between different users and inbound from external signal providers.

notes: Profit Concentration Policy: if one trade idea exceeds 60% of the evaluation profit target, the resulting Master Account requires 4 profitable days (at least 0.5% net realized profit each) before every reward request. FundingPips says this applies to all 1 Step Flex account sizes.
Striking System on every Master size: warning at 1% floating loss on one trade idea; the 2nd warning halves the split, the 3rd reduces it to 20%, and the 4th closes the account.
Minimum reward request is 1% of account size; inactivity breach follows 30 consecutive days with no completed trade.

Refundability is unresolved. The rewards page promises a 4th-reward registration-fee refund for '1 Step', but FundingPips separately labels the legacy 1 Step Model as no longer offered and does not explicitly name 1 Step Flex in the refund promise. refundable stays null.

notes: The 5% max loss trails peak equity and locks at starting balance after equity first reaches 5% profit; it is not comparable to a 5% static limit.
Max Open Risk is 1% combined floating loss. Risk Per Trade Idea is 3% below $50K and 2% at $50K and above.
At least 7 profitable days of 0.25% or more are required in every rolling 30-day period.
Reward eligibility also requires consistency at or below 15%, a 3% safety cushion, and largest loss no greater than largest win.
Reset is available at a 20% discount within 7 calendar days; inactivity is 30 days; minimum reward is 1% of account size.
